reasoning_steps: Step 1: Point charge +Q at center of square base of pyramid.
Step 2: Base flux is zero because field lines lie in base plane.
Step 3: Upper half-space solid angle is 2pi, receiving Q / (2 eps_0).
Step 4: 4 identical upper triangular faces share this flux equally.
Step 5: Flux per face = (Q / (2 eps_0)) / 4 = Q / (8 eps_0).
assumptions_used: Point charge at center of base
diagram_interpretation: Square pyramid with point charge +Q at base center.
